nodes.summary: There are `q ^ k(ω)` colorings constant on the open clusters, where `k(ω)` is the number of clusters.
nodes.title: There are $q^{k(\omega)}$ colorings constant on the open clusters

nodes.summary: Colorings constant on open clusters correspond to colorings of the connected components of the open subgraph.
nodes.title: Cluster-constant colorings as colorings of clusters

nodes.summary: `σ` is constant on every open edge of `ω`, i.e. on every open cluster.
nodes.title: Spin configuration constant on open clusters

nodes.summary: The spin marginal of the Edwards–Sokal measure is the `q`-state Potts measure at inverse temperature `β` and coupling `J`.
nodes.title: Edwards–Sokal spin marginal is the Potts measure

nodes.summary: The bond marginal of the Edwards–Sokal measure is the random-cluster measure with parameters `(1 - e^{-βJ}, q)`.
nodes.title: Edwards–Sokal bond marginal is the random-cluster measure

nodes.summary: The Edwards–Sokal factor of an edge `e` written for an arbitrary pair `(e, b)` with `b` the state of `e`; edges outside `G` get factor `1`.
nodes.title: Edwards–Sokal factor of an arbitrary coordinate and state

nodes.summary: The Edwards–Sokal factor of an edge `e`: `1 - p` if `e` is closed in `ω`, and `p` times the indicator that `σ` agrees at the endpoints if `e` is open.
nodes.title: Edwards–Sokal edge factor

nodes.summary: The normalizing constant `e^{-βJ |E(G)|}` relating the bond marginal to the Potts weight.
nodes.title: Normalizing constant relating the bond sum to the Potts weight

nodes.summary: The spin marginal of the normalized Edwards–Sokal measure.
nodes.title: Spin marginal of the Edwards–Sokal measure

nodes.summary: The bond marginal of the normalized Edwards–Sokal measure.
nodes.title: Bond marginal of the Edwards–Sokal measure

nodes.summary: Bond marginal of the Edwards–Sokal weight: with `p = 1 - e^{-βJ}`, summing over bond configurations gives `e^{-βJ |E|}` times the Potts weight of `σ`.
nodes.title: Edwards–Sokal bond sum is a multiple of the Potts weight

nodes.summary: Spin marginal of the Edwards–Sokal weight: summing over spins gives the random-cluster weight `p^{o(ω)} (1 - p)^{c(ω)} q^{k(ω)}`.
nodes.title: Edwards–Sokal weight summed over spins is the random-cluster weight

nodes.summary: The Edwards–Sokal joint weight of a spin configuration `σ` and a bond configuration `ω`: the product of `esEdgeFactor` over the edges of `G`.
nodes.title: Edwards–Sokal joint weight

nodes.summary: The Edwards–Sokal partition function: the total joint weight.
nodes.title: Edwards–Sokal partition function

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
